concerns.text: The plan states that T029 and T030 will write results to `data/processed/metrics.json`, but the `metrics.schema.yaml` contract defines an array of metric objects with fields `model_name`, `metric_type`, `value`, etc. The described JSON structure (e.g., combined_model_rmse, p_value_dm, ci_lower, ci_upper) does not appear to conform to the contract schema, creating a mismatch between the plan and the contract.
